title: All UAP Data Released While Ross Coulthart Details the Unreleased 'Blue Dots' Film, NASA Chief Says
description: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman says the agency has released all identified UAP materials under the PURSUE effort, but Ross Coulthart disputes the claim over unreleased Apollo records and film.

title: ‘Outer space’ galore as California UFO home goes on market for $1.5M
description: Home buyers with a hankering for the otherworldy take note: a California residence shaped like a UFO could be yours for $1.5million. The Futuro, as it's known, was built in the 1960s by Finnish architect Matti Suuronen but had fallen into disrepair by the following decade.
